cards.name: Shero’s Journey
cards.description: Campers earn badges, make crafts, conduct experiments, and participate in Girl Scout traditions.

financial_aid.text: Limited summer camp scholarships are available.

lunch.text: All attendees will need to pack a lunch and a water bottle each day. Snacks will be provided.

cards.review_notes: The program page lists rising K–5 for each session but explicitly permits current fifth graders/rising sixth graders as campers; the card spans K–6. Dates are assigned to 2026 from the page's Fall 2026 eligibility wording and the parent page's Summer Camp 2026 heading. Aftercare begins at 16:00; regular camp start time is not stated. Program and address details were read through indexed official-page text.
